memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria:
  - Status: persistent daily wheals with mild itching, currently on levocetirizine 5 mg OD and cetirizine 10 mg HS.
  - Plan: continue antihistamines, consider adding montelukast if breakthrough, review eosinophil count.
- Epilepsy:
  - Status: seizure-free for past 3 months on levetiracetam 500 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
  - Plan: maintain current regimen, check serum sodium and creatinine, schedule EEG.
- Due: Next HbA1c due 2025-07-05 (every 3 months).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Allergy to aspirin: develops widespread urticaria and angioedema within 30 minutes of ingestion; requires antihistamine treatment.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been taking the antihistamines as prescribed and have not had a seizure in the last three months. My urticaria is still present daily but less intense than before. I work long hours and sometimes miss doses; I need reminder strategies.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: EEG: Background activity normal for age. No epileptiform discharges or focal abnormalities seen. No evidence of seizure focus.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria:
  - Status: wheals reduced to 3-4 days per week, mild itching, eosinophils slightly up.
  - Plan: add montelukast 10 mg HS, continue levocetirizine and cetirizine, recheck CBC in 6 weeks.
- Epilepsy:
  - Status: seizure-free, medication adherence good.
  - Plan: keep levetiracetam and lamotrigine unchanged, check serum sodium and creatinine.
- Due: Next HbA1c due 2025-09-10.

memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria:
  - Status: remained symptom-free after cetirizine taper, occasional mild flare after stress, controlled with levocetirizine and montelukast.
  - Plan: continue levocetirizine 5 mg OD and montelukast 10 mg HS, keep cetirizine as needed for breakthrough.
- Epilepsy:

  - Plan: maintain current doses, annual EEG considered if clinically indicated.
- Due: Next HbA1c due 2026-12-20.
